app_info.subtitle: Share HTML & code snippets
app_info.description: Oh My Share lets you instantly share HTML files and code snippets with end-to-end encryption. Upload, manage, and share your code with a single command.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new share and returns a URL, but does not modify existing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only stores content in private R2 bucket, does not publish to public internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves user's uploaded assets without modifying data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads from private database, does not access external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or modify any data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves and displays shared content without modification.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads from private storage, does not access external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or modify any data.

justifications.open_world_justification: Only deletes from private storage, does not affect public systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently deletes the asset, which cannot be recovered.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns static service information without any state changes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not access any external systems.

test_cases.user_prompt: Share this HTML code for me: <html><body>Hello</body></html>
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a share URL that can be opened in browser.
Returns a list of user's uploaded assets with URLs.
Returns the HTML content of the shared page.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated requests
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for text editing requests
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is about text editing, not code sharing.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for file management requests
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is about general file management, not HTML sharing.
